item.title: About
item.description:
Hi, I am William. I work on strategy and skill learning for multi-robot systems.

Training one robot to do a hard task is difficult enough. In a team, each robot also has to work out who does what, predict what the others will do, and keep learning while they are learning too. Sometimes the other agent is not a teammate. It might be a moving obstacle or an opponent, and the robot has to work out what it intends and react to it. I work on these problems using reinforcement learning and game theory.
